patch_description: This replaces the coordinate-wise random walk with a population-based, vectorized JADE-style differential-evolution search in barycentric coordinates. The population maintains diverse complete layouts, uses current-to-elite mutations and archive differences to cross combinatorial barriers, and ranks candidates with an annealed soft-min lower-tail objective. The strongest layouts are then polished by solving the locally fixed-orientation maximin problem with SLSQP. This combines global layout-level exploration with an exact local maximin refinement while remaining deterministic and substantially reducing repeated single-point proposal overhead.
